_comment: Machine-readable project context for AI agents. Keep in sync with AGENTS.md. Source of truth for the values below is the code — not this file.

languages.Rust: Everything security/data-critical: Tauri app, Axum server, crypto, DB, ZK, federation, quorum, anchoring
languages.TypeScript: React frontend only (app/public-ui/) — no security-sensitive crypto
languages.Python: verify-only client SDK (clients/python/) — NOT a service, no server role

workspace.note: The repo has 7 Cargo workspaces. Root --workspace reaches only one.

critical_constants.leaf_prefix_format: ADR-0005 structured binary: u8(0x01) || 'OLY' || u8(LEAF) || u8(V1) || lp(shard_id)
critical_constants.leaf_prefix_legacy: OLY:LEAF:V1| (retained as pinned marker only — NOT the live prefix)

leaf_hash_signature: leaf_hash(shard_id, key, value_hash, parser_id, canonical_parser_version, model_hash)
test_vectors: verifiers/test_vectors/vectors.json (SMT — single cross-language source of truth)
python_vectors: clients/python/tests/vectors.json (Python SDK parity — separate generated file)

removed: redaction_validity (ADR-0030 — replaced by signed Merkle fold)

key_env_vars.OLYMPUS_API_PORT: HTTP port for embedded Axum server
key_env_vars.OLYMPUS_INGEST_SIGNING_KEY: persistent Ed25519 key (or OLYMPUS_DEV_SIGNING_KEY=true for dev auto-gen)
key_env_vars.OLYMPUS_BJJ_AUTHORITY_KEY: persistent Baby Jubjub authority key (32-byte hex)
key_env_vars.OLYMPUS_ENV: set to 'production' to enforce strict artifact/ceremony checks (exit 2 on failure)
key_env_vars.DATABASE_URL: external PostgreSQL URL (skips pg_embed when set)
key_env_vars.OLYMPUS_DEV_ALLOW_SINGLE_DATABASE_URL: true = reuse DATABASE_URL for migrations (dev/CI only)
key_env_vars.WISEREPO_ROOT: override for wiserepo MCP server repo root (default: auto-detected)

pre_push_checklist: Do claims match code? (every assertion in ADRs/doc comments verified against implementation)
Have all gates run in every scope? (7 workspaces, verifiers/rust, app/public-ui ESLint from inside dir, pnpm tooling:check)

agent_files.AGENTS.md: THE single agent-instructions document (Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code v2.1.277+)
agent_files.CLAUDE.md: one-line pointer to AGENTS.md; the repository instructions live there
agent_files.context.json: this file — machine-readable project facts for agents
